name: DeKalb County, GA
findings: DeKalb County has 3,896 nonprofit organizations. 1,488 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,162 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, DeKalb County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 27 would.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in DeKalb County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 911 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 61 youth organizations here list public events, compared with about 26 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 61 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
